cost_basis: RESEARCH_ASSUMPTION: conservative fixed cost; not verified actual account tier
position: all cash net of fees; no pyramiding
bracket_policy: gap stop at open; otherwise threshold; stop first if both touched; no same-bar reentry
missing_data_policy: FAIL formal research on any missing/invalid bar or required native field; no fills or zero trade counts
indicator_semantics: SMA full window including current closed close; zscore pandas rolling sample std ddof=1; EMA SMA-seeded recursive alpha=2/(n+1)
source_derivation: Explicit research adaptation to BTC/EUR long-only spot; source short exposure becomes cash; costs and next-open timing are research assumptions
zscore_exit: cash unless current closed z < -entry threshold; source is stateless, not hysteresis
ema_entry_exit: fast crosses above slow with volume>0 enter; crosses below with volume>0 exit
acceptance_policy: Only ELIGIBLE V3 + trusted complete raw/normalized audit permits REAL_MARKET_BACKTEST; raw_unaccepted permits PRIVATE_DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE only
selection_policy: baseline parameter fixed before data; report full grid, no OOS retuning; 2025/2026 halves descriptive only
success_policy: No promotion. RESEARCH_PASSED requires positive OOS net return, >=30 closed OOS trades, OOS Sharpe>0, MDD<=0.3, DSR>=0.95, PBO<=0.1; otherwise failed or inconclusive
limitations: Historical OOS is not prospective evidence
Single market; not evidence of general alpha
CSCV does not purge or embargo overlapping holdings; DSR IID approximation
Base and all grid trials share one hypothesis family
